name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes: v1.8.4 — Marketplace approval hotfix #2: settings.json `$schema` URL changed from `https://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#` to `http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#`. The AJV validator used by YouTrack's project app configuration UI does not resolve HTTPS schema references; the previous HTTPS form caused a runtime error («no schema with key or ref ...») when saving the Group value in Project Settings → Apps → Smart Sprint Planner. The HTTP form is the documented canonical identifier for JSON Schema Draft 7 and is what AJV expects. Includes an accumulated description-text polish in the same file (no logic change). See CHANGELOG.md.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint composition planning, task allocation, history of confirmed sprints with working drafts. Settings are accessible via the «Plugin settings» button in the page header for members of settingsManagerGroup.
